main.description: The container a book club discussion hangs from: one book read cycle, one thread, one stable URI. Every post in the thread names this record as its root, so editing the title or description does not split the discussion across CIDs.

book.description: The edition record being discussed, e.g. a community.lexicon.book.edition at-uri. A plain at-uri rather than a strongRef: the thread follows the edition, it does not pin one revision of it.

read.description: The bookClub.read cycle this thread belongs to. A thread never carries into a later read of the same book.

title.description: The thread title shown in the club's list, e.g. the book title or a discussion prompt.

description.description: Optional framing for the discussion: spoiler policy, chapters covered, reading window.
